author: Ellen G. White
text: They go away offended, even as the disciples left Jesus, murmuring, “This is an hard saying; who can hear it?”

author: Ellen G. White
text: Without attempting to hinder those who were leaving Him, Jesus turned to the twelve and said, “Will ye also go away?”

author: Ellen G. White
text: The knowledge of God and of Christ is the only knowledge which can lead to true and eternal happiness. This knowledge all may obtain

author: Ellen G. White
text: “This do, and thou shalt live,” Jesus said. He presented the law as a divine unity … Supreme love to God and impartial love to man are the principles to be wrought out in the life.

author: Ellen G. White
text: The lawyer found himself a lawbreaker.

author: Ellen G. White
text: Those who study this lesson aright will see that in order to keep the law, it is necessary to have a knowledge of God, for the law is a transcript of His character.

author: Ellen G. White
text: Again he pleaded: “I have set before you life and death; ... choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live: that thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days.”

author: Ellen G. White
text: Faith is trusting God—believing that He loves us and knows best what is for our good.

author: Ellen G. White
text: It grows as exercised in appropriating the word of 254 God. In order to strengthen faith, we must often bring it in contact with the word.

author: Ellen G. White
text: And every soul is to receive life from God’s word for himself. As we must eat for ourselves in order to receive nourishment, so we must receive the word for ourselves. We are not to obtain it merely through the medium of another’s mind.

author: Ellen G. White
text: They had made their choice,—had taken the form without the spirit, the husk without the kernel. Their decision was never afterward reversed; for they walked no more with Jesus.

author: Ellen G. White
text: Peter replied by asking, “Lord, to whom shall we go?” “Thou hast the words of eternal life,” he added. “And we believe and are sure that Thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.”
